crossRefs.note: “You shall bring Aaron and his sons to the door of the Tent of Meeting, and shall wash them with water.
Moses did as Yahweh commanded him; and the congregation was assembled at the door of the Tent of Meeting.
According to all that Yahweh commanded Moses, so the children of Israel did all the work.
Moses saw all the work, and behold, they had done it as Yahweh had commanded. They had done so; and Moses blessed them.
Moses did so. According to all that Yahweh commanded him, so he did.
He will glorify me, for he will take from what is mine, and will declare it to you.

people.name: Aaron
people.line: Moses' brother, first high priest of Israel

translations.web: “You shall do so to Aaron and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded you. You shall consecrate them seven days.
translations.bsb: This is what you are to do for Aaron and his sons based on all that I have commanded you, taking seven days to ordain them.
translations.kjv: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all things which I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate
translations.asv: And thus shalt thou do unto Aaron, and to his sons, according to all that I have commanded thee: seven days shalt thou consecrate them.
